title: AWS documentation example credentials: must be flagged
summary: Values one character away from the published AWS example (a changed final character of the key ID or of the secret). They are no longer the documented example, so they must still be reported. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: These values are published to be copied and were never issued. Reporting them is noise, and a policy that silences them must not also silence a real value in the same position.

expectation.rationale: Mutated documentation, placeholder, template, mask or reference. Expected masking follows a redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
